thread:
maria: Quick status check on console observability roadmap — we need to lock tracing-hook owners and retention targets for dashboards before Friday's deploy. Summary: dashboards want 90/180 day tiers, tracing hooks prioritized for Checkout and Auth flows. Who's on ownership and which dependencies are blocking?

aj: I can take ownership of Checkout tracing hooks. Blocking item: runtime schema change (PR #482) needs merge so hooks can push span attributes. cc @kevin for infra quota.

kevin: FYI infra quota change is in flight, but I need the exact retention numbers to size the hot/cold buckets. If dashboards want 90/180 days, that'll change S3 lifecycle and warm storage estimates.

selena: I'm on the error-analysis views. Can confirm we only need 90 days of full traces for the UI, and 180 days of aggregated error counts. That matches the proposed tiers.

maria: Nice. Can we write the proposed config snippet so infra can estimate? Example: 
```
retention:
  traces_full_days: 90
  error_aggregates_days: 180
tracing_hooks:
  checkout: high-priority
  auth: medium-priority
```

kevin: Perfect. I'll use that. Also, runtime team mentioned the hooks will add ~3 tags/span for Checkout which increases token storage by ~15%. Need a confirmation from Aj on exact attributes.

aj: Tags are `checkout_id`, `payment_method`, `step` — won't be larger than the estimate. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/482. Need a review from runtime infra (David) to avoid any merge reverts.

david: Looking now. I have one comment on serialization. If aj can update the test vector I'll merge by Thu morning. Also we need to add a lightweight canary for the Checkout hook so we can verify latency. ops-bot: Canary pipeline queued (run id: 2026-03-17-007).

selena: For dashboards wiring — I need the event schema change documented. Aj, can you add a short sample event in the PR description? That will unblock my work on the error view mapping.

aj: Yep, adding sample payload now. Will also add a small example curl for hook firing.

maria: Ownership rollup: Aj -> Checkout tracing hooks; Selena -> error-analysis view; Kevin -> retention sizing + infra tickets; David -> runtime review + canary. Action items: David merges runtime change, Kevin files infra ticket with retention tiers, Aj updates PR with samples, Selena finalizes dashboard queries. Can folks confirm ETA?

kevin: Filing infra ticket now — ETA EOD Thu for initial sizing.

aj: I'll update PR and sample by EOD Wed.

david: Tests pass locally, will merge Thu AM after aj's update. Will also kick canary after merge.

selena: I'll draft dashboard queries today, but need the merged schema to finalize. Tentative: merge -> staging dashboards -> canary -> prod.

maria: Great. Last ask: keep this thread for async pings. If anything slips, @maria. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder — deploy window Fri 09:00-11:00 UTC. Add any rollbacks to the incident channel if needed.

maria: Thanks all — ping if any blockers.

aj: ack.

kevin: ack.

selena: ack.

david: ack.
